fuel_consumption.source_quote: As of December 31, 2022, we hedged approximately 21% of our projected fuel requirements for 2023. Based on gallons expected to be consumed in 2023, for every one cent increase in the cost of a gallon of jet fuel, our fuel expense would result in approximately $2.8 million in additional annual fuel expense.

instrument_type_details.notes: Fuel derivative contracts (crude oil call options, resumed from no-hedge in FY2021). Not designated as ASC 815 hedges. FV net asset $5.3M at Dec 31 2022. 57,288 thousand gallons (= 57.288M gallons) settling December 2023, covering ~21% of projected 2023 fuel requirements.

warnings: 57,288 gallons (thousands) from position table; 21% pct from item7a text; hedging resumed after no hedges at Dec 31 2021
